description: Invented field-office returns for a tool-use walkthrough. These are not observations from a national statistical office.

definitions.text: For each office, select the highest revision whose status is approved. A newer draft does not replace an approved return. Rows are complete replacements, not increments. Eligible cases equal issued minus ineligible cases. Completed cases are a subset of eligible cases. The units column applies to all three count columns: cases has multiplier 1; thousands_of_cases has multiplier 1000. Pool counts across offices, then divide total completed by total eligible. This illustrative completion rate is not a survey-weighted estimate or an official response-rate standard.

offices.note: The corrected approved return replaces the earlier approved return. Both cover September 2026.
Every numeric count is expressed in thousands of cases, including the completed count. The values are exact in this synthetic example.
Revision 3 is a draft awaiting approval. Use the highest approved revision, not simply the highest revision number.
